name: Naval Base Kitsap
tagline: The Navy's Pacific Northwest hub: ballistic-missile submarines at Bangor and Puget Sound Naval Shipyard at Bremerton, across the Kitsap Peninsula.
_note: Navy base (Kitsap Peninsula, WA; Bremerton + Bangor, merged 2004). Facts verified from official sources (cnrnw.cnic.navy.mil, Naval Hospital Bremerton, DeCA/NEX, Wikipedia for corroborated headline facts). BAH MHA WA306 (Bremerton) via the bah_rates single source of truth. Housing partner not named pending confirmation (start with the housing office). Washington is TRICARE West. Medium-confidence flags: base coords (approx), representative off-base ZIP 98311 (Bremerton/Silverdale). Rechecked 2026-11-12 (research/kitsap-facts.md): Poulsbo is North Kitsap SD; Hunt runs 1,733 homes (MOS), 41 at Bremerton; Naval Hospital Bremerton has no ER or L&D; Nimitz left 3/7/26; nonresident members keep home plates; gates matched to map, hours unverified.

data.Shipyard: Puget Sound Naval Shipyard (one of the Navy's nuclear shipyards)
data.Also: Puget Sound Naval Shipyard & Intermediate Maintenance Facility at Bremerton; Naval Undersea Warfare Center at Keyport

source.label: Military OneSource, Naval Base Kitsap overview

sections.title: Mission & Identity
data: Naval Base Kitsap spans Bangor, Bremerton, Keyport, Manchester and Jackson Park on the Kitsap Peninsula. Bangor works with the submarine community, including the West Coast's Ohio-class submarines, and Bremerton with the ship community.

Bremerton is home to Puget Sound Naval Shipyard. The Navy plans to homeport up to eight Columbia-class submarines at Bangor, with the first expected in 2032. USS Nimitz left Bremerton for the last time on March 7, 2026.

sections.title: Bremerton or Bangor? Puget Sound Living

data.subtitle: Kitsap's two main sites, Bangor near Silverdale and the Bremerton shipyard, are about 20 minutes apart, so the site you report to shapes where you live. Then the school district behind the address matters most.
intro: Bangor, near Silverdale, works with the submarine community; Bremerton is the shipyard side. Most base family housing is at Bangor and The Landings, and the Housing Service Center is at Bangor Plaza. Families who live south of Bremerton (Port Orchard, Gig Harbor) drive through Gorst, where WSDOT expects travel times to more than double within 10 years.

School districts differ more than taxes do: class of 2025 graduation runs from 72.8% in the Bremerton district to 95.0% on Bainbridge Island (state 82.6%), and a Bremerton mailing address can be in the Central Kitsap district. Washington has no personal income tax, and sales tax is 9.2% or 9.3% everywhere nearby.

recommendations.advice: Bremerton is about 4 minutes from the shipyard's Naval Avenue Gate and has the lowest typical home value of the nearby towns ($479,232, Zillow, September 2026), but the Bremerton School District's class of 2025 graduated 72.8%; some Bremerton addresses are in Central Kitsap's district (84.5%). Port Orchard (South Kitsap, 84.8%) is about 15 minutes away, through Gorst.
Silverdale (Central Kitsap schools, 84.5%) is about 8 minutes from the Trident Main Gate and Poulsbo (North Kitsap schools, 89.8%) about 12. Typical home values are $601,583 and $663,190.

The state ferry takes about 60 minutes from Bremerton and 35 from Bainbridge Island to Seattle ($11.35 walk-on). Kitsap Transit's Bremerton fast ferry takes 30 minutes but was due to cut weekday round trips from 20 to 13 in September 2026, so check its current schedule.

Hunt Military Communities runs the homes. Military OneSource counts 1,038 at Bangor, 632 at The Landings (formerly Jackson Park) in Bremerton and 41 on the Bremerton base itself. Families in EFMP categories 4 and 5 get wait-list priority.

sections.title: Gates & Access
data: The Bangor Visitor Control Center is at the Trident Main Gate, 1035 Trident Boulevard (360-396-4665), open weekdays 7 a.m. to 3:20 p.m. and closed weekends and holidays, so plan guest visits ahead. Bremerton has its own visitor center; base operator 360-476-3636.
Family members over 10 need a dependent ID card. We couldn't confirm gate hours from an official page, so check with your sponsor or the base before you go.

source.label: Military OneSource, NB Kitsap motor vehicles

sections.title: On-Base Housing
data: Hunt Military Communities runs the privatized family housing. Military OneSource counts 1,733 homes: 1,038 at Bangor, 632 at The Landings (formerly Jackson Park, near Naval Hospital Bremerton), 41 at Bremerton and 22 at Keyport (Hunt's own site says 1,100). Your control date is the first thing that sets your wait list place, families in EFMP categories 4 and 5 get priority, and we found no published wait times.
Housing Service Center: Bangor Plaza, 2720 Ohio Street, Silverdale, 360-396-4399, weekdays 7:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. Single E-4 and below with under four years of service live in unaccompanied housing.

sections.title: Schools
data: There are no DoD schools here. Bangor housing feeds Central Kitsap or North Kitsap schools, The Landings feeds Bremerton or Central Kitsap, and Keyport feeds North Kitsap; Poulsbo and Kingston are North Kitsap. Class of 2025 four-year graduation: Bainbridge Island 95.0%, North Kitsap 89.8%, Peninsula (Gig Harbor) 88.7%, South Kitsap 84.8%, Central Kitsap 84.5%, Bremerton 72.8%; state 82.6%.
A Bremerton mailing address can be in the Central Kitsap district, so confirm the district for any address. School Liaison: 360-340-2824.

data.Care: Outpatient care and an urgent care clinic (8 a.m. to 4 p.m. daily as of July 2025; call 360-475-4000 to check); no emergency room since 2013 or 2014 and no labor and delivery since spring 2022. It relies on St. Michael Medical Center in Silverdale, which has an ER, for deliveries; branch clinic at Bangor for active duty.

data.Commissary: Commissaries at Bangor (2604 Ohio Street) and Bremerton (120 S. Dewey Street), both open 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. daily

intro: Whether to rent or buy is the biggest money decision of most PCS moves, and the answer is mostly about how long you'll be here and how steady the local market is.
rent: Your tour is short (about two years or less) or you expect to be at sea often.
You want time to learn the peninsula before committing to a neighborhood.
You'd rather not gamble on resale timing when you PCS out.
Your BAH comfortably covers rent in the areas you'd consider.
buy: You expect to be here three or more years.
You want to use your VA loan and build equity instead of paying rent.
The Kitsap market fits your budget for a home you like.
You've found a neighborhood and commute you're confident about.
data.bottom_line: There is no universal right answer. The Bremerton metro (Kitsap County) typical home value is about 20% below the Seattle metro's ($579,111 against $720,147, Zillow, September 2026), and Kitsap had the tightest supply in the NWMLS area in October 2026. Run your BAH against the rent and home prices above, weigh your tour length and your commute through Gorst, and talk to a lender and an agent who work with military families before you commit.

intro: The first month at a new duty station is mostly logistics. Knocking these out early makes everything else easier.

steps.title: Line up temporary lodging
steps.text: Book Navy Gateway Inns or a short-term rental before you arrive. You can claim Temporary Lodging Expense (TLE) for a limited number of days while you house-hunt.

steps.title: In-process and update DEERS
steps.text: Report to your command and finance, and make sure DEERS and ID cards are current for every family member so TRICARE and base access work.

steps.title: Start with the Housing Office
steps.text: Check on-base availability and get the housing office's read on the Bremerton and Bangor sides before you sign anything.

steps.title: Sort your vehicle and base access
steps.text: If Washington isn't your legal residence, you can keep your home-state registration, and so can a spouse whose car is registered to you or jointly. If you register in Washington, you may be exempt from excise and regional transit taxes as a registered owner who certifies a home of record elsewhere (Form 420044 and your LES); 2009 and newer cars must meet California emission standards. Buying a car here after 90 days means Washington sales or use tax. Every car used on base must be registered with base Pass and ID.

steps.title: Enroll the kids in school
steps.text: Bangor housing feeds Central Kitsap or North Kitsap schools; The Landings feeds Bremerton or Central Kitsap; Keyport feeds North Kitsap. Off base, confirm the district for the exact address. School Liaison: 360-340-2824.

steps.title: Set up healthcare
steps.text: Update your TRICARE enrollment. Naval Hospital Bremerton has no emergency room and no labor and delivery, so know where St. Michael Medical Center in Silverdale and the nearest civilian ER are.

data.a: Bangor, near Silverdale, works with the submarine community; Bremerton is home to Puget Sound Naval Shipyard; Keyport has the Naval Undersea Warfare Center. Military OneSource counts 15,293 active duty.

Your site decides it: the two main gates are about 20 minutes apart with no traffic. Most base family housing is at Bangor and The Landings, and families living south of Bremerton drive through Gorst, one of the busiest routes in Kitsap County.

Near Bangor: Silverdale (Central Kitsap schools) and Poulsbo and Kingston (North Kitsap schools). Near the shipyard: Bremerton and Port Orchard (South Kitsap). Bainbridge Island has the highest graduation rate (95.0%) and the highest prices.
Naval Base Kitsap is MHA WA306 (Bremerton). Use the calculator above for your grade.

data.q: Does Washington tax my military pay?
data.a: No. Washington has no personal income tax today; a 9.9% tax on income over $1 million starts in 2028. Sales tax is 9.2% in Bremerton, Silverdale and Bainbridge Island and 9.3% in Port Orchard and Poulsbo.

data.q: Is there an emergency room at Naval Hospital Bremerton?
data.a: No. It has an urgent care clinic (8 a.m. to 4 p.m. daily as of July 2025) and hasn't delivered babies since spring 2022. St. Michael Medical Center in Silverdale has an emergency department, and freestanding ERs opened in 2025 in East Bremerton, Bremerton and Port Orchard. In an emergency, call 911.
